title: Proxmox node
description: One PVE node in depth: CPU, load, memory, swap, root disk, NICs, its guests and storages.

list.name: bucket
list.label: Cluster
list.description: InfluxDB bucket: pve_cluster (the lylat cluster) or pve_greatfox (the standalone greatfox).

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "host",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "host",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

panels.title: State
panels.description: UP if the node reported within the last minute of the time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and r._field == "avg1")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: r._time) < 60000000000 then 1 else 0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "uptime"))
  |> last()

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Busy share of all cores.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "cpu"))
  |> last()

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used = total - available.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal"))
  |> last()
              |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
              |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.memused / r.memtotal}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "swapused" or r._field == "swaptotal"))
  |> last()
              |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
              |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r.swaptotal > 0.0 then r.swapused / r.swaptotal else 0.0}))

panels.title: Root FS
panels.description: The node's root filesystem (local storage lives on it).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "per"))
  |> last()
              |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value) / 100.0}))

panels.title: Load / core
panels.description: Load averages divided by the cores; above 1 means tasks wait for a CPU.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "avg1" or r._field == "avg5" or r._field == "avg15" or r._field == "cpus"))
  |> last()
              |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
              |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _1m: r.avg1 / r.cpus, _5m: r.avg5 / r.cpus, _15m: r.avg15 / r.cpus}))

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: On this node now: running VMs and CTs, stopped guests (templates not counted), templates.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename == "${node}" and (r._field == "status" or r._field == "template"))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({vmid: r.vmid, nodename: r.nodename, object: r.object, _field: r._field, _value: string(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "nodename", "object"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> reduce(identity: {vms: 0, cts: 0, stopped: 0, templates: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
       vms: accumulator.vms + (if r.status == "running" and r.object == "qemu" then 1 else 0),
       cts: accumulator.cts + (if r.status == "running" and r.object == "lxc" then 1 else 0),
       stopped: accumulator.stopped + (if r.status != "running" and not exists r.template then 1 else 0),
       templates: accumulator.templates + (if exists r.template then 1 else 0)}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and ((r._measurement == "cpustat" and r._field == "cpus") or
       (r._measurement == "memory" and (r._field == "memtotal" or r._field == "swaptotal")) or (r._measurement == "blockstat" and r._field == "blocks")))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.title: node_exporter
panels.description: Prometheus node_exporter on this node; click for Node Exporter Full (hardware, disks, temperatures).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Busy share of all cores, and the share spent waiting for I/O.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "wait"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "cpu" then "busy" else "IO wait"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: 1, 5 and 15 minute load averages; the dashed line is the node's core count.

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "avg1" or r._field == "avg5" or r._field == "avg15" or r._field == "cpus"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "cpus" then "cores" else strings.trimPrefix(v: r._field, prefix: "avg") + "m"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used (total - available) and available stack up to the total. ZFS ARC shows only on nodes with ZFS.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memavailable" or r._field == "arcsize"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field != "arcsize" or r._value > 1048576.0)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "memused" then "used" else if r._field == "memavailable" then "available" else "ZFS ARC"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and (r._field == "swapused" or r._field == "swaptotal"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "swapused" then "used" else "total"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Root filesystem
panels.description: Used share of /, as df reports it.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and r._field == "per")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 100.0}))
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: "used"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Physical NICs
panels.description: Every physical NIC; inbound up, outbound down.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and r.instance =~ /^(eth|en|wl)/ and (r._field == "receive" or r._field == "transmit"))
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.instance + (if r._field == "receive" then " in" else " out")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Bridges and bonds
panels.description: Linux bridges (guest traffic and VLANs) and bonds.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and r.instance =~ /^(vmbr|bond)/ and (r._field == "receive" or r._field == "transmit"))
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.instance + (if r._field == "receive" then " in" else " out")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Interfaces
panels.description: Physical NICs, bonds, bridges and VLAN interfaces (guest tap/veth and firewall bridges left out). Totals are bytes since the node booted.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and r.instance !~ /^(tap|veth|fwbr|fwpr|fwln|lo$)/ and (r._field == "receive" or r._field == "transmit"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({instance: r.instance, _field: r._field + "_rate", _value: r._value * 8.0}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["instance"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r.host == "${node}" and r.instance !~ /^(tap|veth|fwbr|fwpr|fwln|lo$)/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({instance: r.instance, _field: r._field, _value: string(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["instance"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({instance: r.instance, type: r.type, receive: float(v: r.receive), transmit: float(v: r.transmit)}))

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: Now (end of the time range). Memory is what the guest uses on the host (VM: memhost, CT: mem); Configured is its maximum. CPU is the share of its own vCPUs. Click a name for the guest's dashboard.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename == "${node}" and
       (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus" or r._field == "mem" or r._field == "memhost" or r._field == "maxmem" or r._field == "uptime" or r._field == "maxdisk"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({vmid: r.vmid, cpu: r.cpu, cpus: r.cpus, used: if exists r.memhost then r.memhost else r.mem,
       maxmem: r.maxmem, mempct: if r.maxmem > 0.0 then (if exists r.memhost then r.memhost else r.mem) / r.maxmem else 0.0,
       uptime: r.uptime, maxdisk: r.maxdisk}))

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename == "${node}" and (r._field == "status" or r._field == "tags"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "host", "nodename", "object"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename == "${node}" and
       (r._field == "diskread" or r._field == "diskwrite" or r._field == "netin" or r._field == "netout"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with netin: r.netin * 8.0, netout: r.netout * 8.0}))

panels.title: Guest CPU (cores)
panels.description: Cores each guest keeps busy (CPU share x vCPUs), stacked.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename == "${node}" and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.cpu * r.cpus}))
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Guest memory (host)
panels.description: Host memory each guest uses (VM: memhost, CT: mem), stacked.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename == "${node}" and (r._field == "mem" or r._field == "memhost"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if exists r.memhost then r.memhost else r.mem}))
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Guest disk I/O
panels.description: Read + write per guest, stacked.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename == "${node}" and (r._field == "diskread" or r._field == "diskwrite"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.diskread + r.diskwrite}))
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Guest network
panels.description: In + out per guest, stacked.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename == "${node}" and (r._field == "netin" or r._field == "netout"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (r.netin + r.netout) * 8.0}))
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Used / total. Shared storages once, local ones per node.

targets.query:
import "date"
nums = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and r.nodename == "${node}" and
       (r._field == "total" or r._field == "used" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared" or r._field == "active" or r._field == "enabled"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
strs = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and r.nodename == "${node}" and (r._field == "type" or r._field == "content"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
join(tables: {n: nums, s: strs}, on: ["host", "nodename"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with storage: if r.shared == 1.0 then r.host else r.host + " (" + r.nodename + ")",
       pct: if r.total > 0.0 then r.used / r.total else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["storage"])
  |> first(column: "storage")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["pct"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["storage", "pct"])

panels.title: Storages
panels.description: Now, shared storages once. Growth is the change of used space over the time range, per day; Full in extrapolates it ("not filling up" when not growing). Click a storage: Ceph storages open the Ceph cluster dashboard, local ones their node.

targets.query:
import "date"
cur = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and r.nodename == "${node}" and
       (r._field == "total" or r._field == "used" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared" or r._field == "active" or r._field == "enabled"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
strs = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and r.nodename == "${node}" and (r._field == "type" or r._field == "content"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
used = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and r.nodename == "${node}" and r._field == "used")
growth = join(tables: {f: used |> first(), l: used |> last()}, on: ["host", "nodename"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({host: r.host, nodename: r.nodename,
       rate: if r._time_l > r._time_f then (r._value_l - r._value_f) / (float(v: int(v: r._time_l) - int(v: r._time_f)) / 1000000000.0) else 0.0}))
join(tables: {a: join(tables: {n: cur, s: strs}, on: ["host", "nodename"]), g: growth}, on: ["host", "nodename"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       storage: if r.shared == 1.0 then r.host else r.host + " (" + r.nodename + ")",
       nodename: if r.shared == 1.0 then "all" else r.nodename,
       type: r.type, content: r.content, shared: r.shared, active: r.active, enabled: r.enabled,
       used: r.used, avail: r.avail, total: r.total, pct: if r.total > 0.0 then r.used / r.total else 0.0,
       day: r.rate * 86400.0,
       full: if r.rate > 0.0 then r.avail / r.rate else -1.0,
       link: if r.type == "rbd" or r.type == "cephfs" then "/d/ceph-cluster/ceph-cluster?orgId=1"
             else if r.shared == 1.0 then "/d/proxmox-storage/proxmox-storage?var-bucket=${bucket}&var-storage=" + r.host
             else "/d/proxmox-node/proxmox-node?var-bucket=${bucket}&var-node=" + r.nodename}))
  |> group(columns: ["storage"])
  |> first(column: "storage")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["pct"], desc: true)

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: Hottest sensor per hwmon chip (node_exporter). Empty without node_exporter (greatfox).

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time each physical disk was busy (OSD and boot disks).
